issues.description: The solution repository's PersonResource declares getAllPersons() to return ResponseEntity<Set<Person>> while both the template repository's PersonResource declares ResponseEntity<List<Person>> and the PersonService.getAll() method (in template and solution) returns List<Person>. This mismatch between the controller's declared response generic type and the actual service return type (List) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students when comparing template and solution and may cause compilation or API contract misunderstandings.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the controller return type consistent with the service return type and the template. Either change the solution's PersonResource.getAllPersons() signature back to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> (recommended), or change PersonService.getAll() to return a Set<Person> in both template and solution and update any callers/tests accordingly so the API contract is consistent across template, solution, and tests.
